channel.title: KrakenD Blog
channel.description: News, release notes and technical articles about the KrakenD API Gateway.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.6, EE 3.0.6 and EE 2.13.16 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that fix a hang in the HTTP cache and JWT claim propagation, and move Lambda to the AWS SDK for Go v2.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.5, EE 3.0.5 and EE 2.13.15 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade OpenTelemetry to fix a baggage header vulnerability, plus Kafka async agent, WebSocket and plugin fixes in Enterprise.

item.title: Choosing an API Gateway for Aggregation and BFF: A Practical Checklist
item.description: A practical checklist to evaluate an API gateway for aggregation and BFF: response shaping, partial failures, caching, observability, and how to test each.

item.title: KrakenD Partners with AITERA Solutions to Connect Enterprise Services in Malaysia
item.description: AITERA Solutions, a Malaysian managed security service provider, pairs KrakenD's API Gateway with its infrastructure, automation, and integration expertise.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.4, EE 3.0.4 and EE 2.13.14 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade Go to 1.27.4 and CEL, plus quota, AI Gateway and plugin fixes in Enterprise.

item.title: What Is an AI Gateway? Architecture, Controls and Use Cases
item.description: Learn how an AI gateway routes, secures and observes LLM traffic, how it differs from an API gateway, and when platform teams need one.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.3, EE 3.0.3 and EE 2.13.13 Update Released
item.description: Security patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade Go JOSE and x/net, and fix a JWK cache collision in the CE JWT validator.

item.title: CVE-2026-98432: Linux Kernel Flaw Exposing KrakenD on Unpatched Hosts
item.description: A critical Linux kernel bug lets remote attackers target KrakenD on unpatched hosts. Patch the kernel, and disable MPTCP in KrakenD until you do.

item.title: KrakenD Partners with Aice Global to Deliver Secure API Management in India
item.description: Aice Global, an information security firm based in Kochi, pairs KrakenD's API Gateway with its auditing and VAPT expertise to secure enterprise APIs in India.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.2, EE 3.0.2 and EE 2.13.12 Update Released
item.description: Urgent patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that distrust compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs, plus OpenAPI, AMQP and AI Gateway fixes.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.1, EE 3.0.1 and EE 2.13.11 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE addressing several Go CVEs, plus WebSocket compression and AI Gateway fixes in Enterprise.

item.title: KrakenD Partners with CGK Solutions to Secure API Integration in Italy
item.description: KrakenD partners with CGK Solutions, an Italian software firm serving Public Administration and Pharma, to secure API integration in regulated industries.

item.title: KrakenD CE v3.0 Released
item.description: KrakenD CE v3.0 opens Series 3 with wildcard JWT claim paths, the HTTP method in endpoint logs, a leaner binary, and the removal of deprecated components.

item.title: KrakenD 3.0 Is Here: AI Router, Semantic Cache, and On-the-Fly Stream Manipulation
item.description: Today we release KrakenD 3.0, the first of Series 3, with an AI Router, provider failover, Semantic Cache, Prompt Guard, and MCP authentication. Here's what ships and what's next.

item.description: KrakenD welcomes SoftwareOne as an official partner, pairing KrakenD's API and AI Gateway with SoftwareOne's global reach across 60+ countries to help organizations modernize their platforms.
